plugin.title: b3l0w Audit
plugin.description: Arch/CachyOS advisories, pending updates for Noctalia and Umbriel, and whether the b3l0w CLI needs a rebuild.

check_hours.label: Vulnerability scan interval (hours)
check_hours.desc: Hours between arch-audit runs against the Arch Security Team tracker.

updates_minutes.label: Update check interval (minutes)
updates_minutes.desc: Minutes between pacman -Qu and the b3l0w CLI freshness check.

notify_new.label: Notify about new advisories
notify_new.desc: Toast when a check finds advisories that were not there before.

notify_min_severity.label: Minimum severity to notify
notify_min_severity.desc: Advisories below this severity stay silent.

ignore_packages.label: Ignored packages
ignore_packages.desc: An advisory is hidden only when every package it lists is ignored here.

hide_when_clean.label: Hide when clean
hide_when_clean.desc: Hide the widget when there are no advisories and nothing to update.

glyph.label: Bar icon
glyph.desc: Glyph used while advisories are present. Clean checks show a check shield.

panel_mode.label: Panel style
panel_mode.desc: Compact attached panel or large floating one.

animations.label: Animations
animations.desc: Staggered rows when switching tabs or pages.

cli_bin.label: b3l0w CLI binary
cli_bin.desc: Path of the compiled binary. Its mtime is compared with the newest .go file.

cli_repo.label: b3l0w repo
cli_repo.desc: Folder with the Go sources; Update all runs go build ./cmd/b3l0w here.

settings.settings.layout_mode.label: Layout
settings.settings.layout_mode.desc: Automatic: the host measures the panel and the content fits it. Fixed: the plugin asks for an explicit width.

panel.title: Audit
panel.update_all_hint: Lists pending updates and rebuilds the CLI
panel.update_all_hint_stale: CLI out of date: Update all rebuilds it
panel.update_all_tip: Refresh the list, then go build the b3l0w CLI. Packages are never installed without confirmation.
panel.missing: arch-audit is not installed: cached results only
panel.fix_only_tip: Only advisories that already have a fixed version.
panel.update_one_tip: Runs pkexec pacman -S --needed for this package. Arch does not support partial upgrades: prefer a full upgrade.
panel.more_rows: +{count} more pending (full list in a terminal)

cli.title: b3l0w CLI
cli.rebuild_tip: Runs go build ./cmd/b3l0w against the binary path from settings.

updates.no_pkexec: pkexec is not available: copy the command and run it in a terminal.

tooltip.hint: Left click details · Right click check now

settings.layout_mode.label: Layout
settings.layout_mode.desc: Automatic: the host measures the panel and the content fits it. Fixed: the plugin asks for an explicit width.
